description: Aménagements Cyclables Ouest Cornouaille is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Syndicat Intercommunautaire Ouest Cornouaille Aménagement. This dataset contains all cycling facilities in the broad sense in use at the time the data was created. Coverage: Syndicat Intercommunautaire Ouest Cornouaille Aménagement. The portal shows the English title as "West Cornwall Cycling Facilities" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Syndicat Intercommunautaire Ouest Cornouaille Aménagement. Its keywords include cvcb, piste-cyclable, chaussee-a-voie-centrale-banalisee, voie-verte, bande-cyclable, cap-sizun-pointe-du-raz. The listing shows 2 download or service links in GEOJSON, HTML. The listing shows 2023-07-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
